- name: Apply one finite explicitly selected membership observation
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  vars: {identity_run: false}
  tasks:
  - when: identity_run | bool and not ansible_check_mode
    no_log: true
    block:
    - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        phase_substage: protected-state-validation
        member_results: []
        operations_attempted: 0
    - ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: [python3, '{{ playbook_dir }}/phase-lock.py', --locked, '{{ phase_work }}', '{{ phase_group_receipt }}']
      changed_when: false
    - name: Refresh issuer evidence even for an empty roster
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: [/opt/perkforge/bin/refresh-identity-evidence, '{{ phase_inputs }}', '{{ phase_work }}']
      changed_when: false
    - ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: [python3, '{{ playbook_dir }}/membership-state.py', '{{ phase_inputs }}', '{{ phase_work }}', '{{ phase_group_receipt }}']
      changed_when: false
      register: verified_state
    - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        membership_state: '{{ verified_state.stdout | from_json }}'
        initial_envelope: '{{ lookup("file", phase_work + "/envelope.json") | from_json }}'
    - ansible.builtin.include_tasks: member-one.yaml
      loop: '{{ membership_state.subjects }}'
      loop_control: {loop_var: selected_subject}
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ phase_work }}/member-results.json'
        mode: '0600'
        content: '{{ member_results | to_json }}'
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ phase_work }}/result.json'
        mode: '0600'
        content: "{{ {'phase':('NoDesiredMembers' if membership_state.subjects | length == 0 else ('MembershipReady' if member_results | rejectattr('stage','in',['Granted','Revoked','NoOwnedMembership']) | list | length == 0 else 'MembershipPending')),'invocation':identity_invocation,'operations_attempted':operations_attempted,'completed_subjects':member_results | length,'pending_subjects':member_results | rejectattr('stage','in',['Granted','Revoked','NoOwnedMembership']) | list | length,'membership_ready':(membership_state.subjects | length > 0 and member_results | rejectattr('stage','in',['Granted','Revoked','NoOwnedMembership']) | list | length == 0),'current_group_readback_claim':true} | to_json }}"
    rescue:
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ phase_work }}/member-results.json'
        mode: '0600'
        content: '{{ member_results | default([]) | to_json }}'
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ phase_work }}/result.json'
        mode: '0600'

    - ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: Membership phase stopped; protected ownership and bounded result retained.
    always:
    - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        phase_envelope: {}
        selected_identity: {}
        verified_state: {}

# Exact precreated object only. No create/delete, no Secret access, no data adoption.
- ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    receipt_url: '{{ identity_kubernetes_origin }}/api/v1/namespaces/{{ identity_receipt_namespace }}/configmaps/{{ identity_receipt_name }}'
    receipt_headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer {{ lookup("file",phase_api_token) | trim }}'}

    url: '{{ receipt_url }}'
    headers: '{{ receipt_headers }}'
    validate_certs: true
    ca_path: '{{ phase_api_ca }}'
    use_proxy: false
    use_netrc: false
    follow_redirects: none
    unredirected_headers: [Authorization]
    timeout: 10
  register: receipt_before
- ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.uid == identity_receipt_uid
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.name == identity_receipt_name
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.namespace == identity_receipt_namespace
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.resourceVersion is match('^[0-9]+$')
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.labels['app.kubernetes.io/managed-by'] == 'perkforge-identity'
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.labels['perkforge.dev/context'] == identity_context
    - receipt_before.json.metadata.annotations['perkforge.dev/desired-invocation'] == identity_invocation
    - receipt_before.json.data | default({}) | list | difference(['receipt.json']) | length == 0
    - (receipt_before.json.data | default({})).get('receipt.json','') | length <= 262144
- name: First attempt cannot adopt existing data; later attempts require exact predecessor
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that: (receipt_before.json.data | default({})).get('receipt.json','') == ''
  when: identity_previous_invocation == ''
- ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    prior_envelope: '{{ receipt_before.json.data["receipt.json"] | from_json }}'
  when: identity_previous_invocation != ''
- ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - prior_envelope.invocation == identity_previous_invocation
    - prior_envelope.context == identity_context
    - prior_envelope.receipt_uid == identity_receipt_uid
  when: identity_previous_invocation != ''
- name: CAS only the owned data after UID, version and desired-attempt checks
  ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: '{{ receipt_url }}'
    method: PATCH
    headers: '{{ receipt_headers | combine({"Content-Type":"application/json-patch+json"}) }}'
    body_format: json
    body:
    - {op: test, path: /metadata/uid, value: '{{ identity_receipt_uid }}'}
    - {op: test, path: /metadata/resourceVersion, value: '{{ receipt_before.json.metadata.resourceVersion }}'}
    - {op: test, path: /metadata/annotations/perkforge.dev~1desired-invocation, value: '{{ identity_invocation }}'}
    - op: add
      path: /data
      value: {receipt.json: '{{ lookup("file",phase_work + "/envelope.json") }}'}
    validate_certs: true
    ca_path: '{{ phase_api_ca }}'
    use_proxy: false
    use_netrc: false
    follow_redirects: none
    unredirected_headers: [Authorization]
    timeout: 10
    status_code: 200
- ansible.builtin.uri:
    url: '{{ receipt_url }}'
    headers: '{{ receipt_headers }}'
    validate_certs: true
    ca_path: '{{ phase_api_ca }}'
    use_proxy: false
    use_netrc: false
    follow_redirects: none
    unredirected_headers: [Authorization]
    timeout: 10
  register: receipt_after
- ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - receipt_after.json.metadata.uid == identity_receipt_uid
    - receipt_after.json.metadata.annotations['perkforge.dev/desired-invocation'] == identity_invocation
    - receipt_after.json.data['receipt.json'] == lookup('file',phase_work + '/envelope.json')

set -euo pipefail
# Arguments contain paths only, never credential values. No action by default.

  printf '%s\n' 'INERT: explicit --apply TOKEN_FILE RECEIPT_FILE INPUTS_FILE required.'

fi
python3 "$here/verify_group_paths.py" --token "$2" --receipt "$3" --inputs "$4" --prepare
# Native flock holds the lock for the entire child process; fail rather than queue.
export PERKFORGE_GROUP_LOCK_OWNER=$$

  ansible-playbook -i localhost, "$here/ensure-groups.yaml" -e "@$4" \
  -e "gitlab_native_token_file=$2" -e "gitlab_group_receipt_file=$3"

# Bounded native tenant-group membership only; never a whole-person offboard.
- name: Reconcile one approved GitLab tenant-group membership
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    gitlab_membership_run: false
    gitlab_membership_operation: inspect
    gitlab_membership_scope: UNAPPROVED
    gitlab_membership_recovery_verified: false
    gitlab_native_origin: https://gitlab.UNCONFIGURED.invalid
    gitlab_native_ca_file: /UNCONFIGURED/public-ca
    gitlab_native_token_file: /UNCONFIGURED/group-writer-token
    gitlab_native_attestation_file: /UNCONFIGURED/attestation.json
    gitlab_native_grant_receipt_file: /UNCONFIGURED/grant.json
    gitlab_native_group_receipt_file: /UNCONFIGURED/group-receipt.json
    gitlab_native_membership_inputs_file: /UNCONFIGURED/inputs.json
    gitlab_native_user_id: 0
    gitlab_native_subject: UNCONFIGURED
    gitlab_native_group_id: 0
    gitlab_native_group_path: UNCONFIGURED
    gitlab_native_access_level: 0
  module_defaults:
    ansible.builtin.uri:
      validate_certs: true
      ca_path: '{{ gitlab_native_ca_file }}'
      use_proxy: false
      use_netrc: false
      follow_redirects: none
      unredirected_headers: [PRIVATE-TOKEN]
      timeout: 20
  tasks:
  - ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: 'Default/check mode contacts no API. One selected native group membership only; no user approval/linking/admin grant, global block, session/token revocation or descendant/project membership deletion.'
  - when: gitlab_membership_run | bool and not ansible_check_mode
    no_log: true
    block:
    - name: Require validated literal inputs and this invocation's whole-context lock
      ansible.builtin.command:
        argv: [python3, '{{ playbook_dir }}/verification/membership_inputs.py', '{{ gitlab_native_token_file }}', '{{ gitlab_native_attestation_file }}', '{{ gitlab_native_group_receipt_file }}', '{{ gitlab_native_membership_inputs_file }}', '{{ gitlab_native_grant_receipt_file }}', --locked]
      changed_when: false
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - gitlab_membership_operation in ['inspect','grant','revoke']
        - gitlab_membership_scope == 'gitlab-membership-' + gitlab_membership_operation + '-v1'
        - gitlab_membership_recovery_verified | bool
        - gitlab_native_origin is match('^https://[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?$')
        - "'UNCONFIGURED' not in gitlab_native_origin"
        - gitlab_native_user_id | type_debug == 'int' and gitlab_native_user_id > 0
        - gitlab_native_group_id | type_debug == 'int' and gitlab_native_group_id > 0
        - gitlab_native_subject != 'UNCONFIGURED' and gitlab_native_subject | length > 0
        - gitlab_native_group_path is match('^tenants/[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$')
        - gitlab_native_access_level in [20,30,40,50]
    - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        gitlab_native_headers: {PRIVATE-TOKEN: "{{ lookup('file',gitlab_native_token_file) | trim }}"}
        cacheable: false
    - name: Verify dedicated non-admin writer bot and exact parent token authority
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: '{{ gitlab_native_origin }}/api/v4/{{ item }}'
        headers: '{{ gitlab_native_headers }}'
      loop: [user, personal_access_tokens/self]
      register: gitlab_writer_identity
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.bot is sameas true
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.state == 'active'
        - not (gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.is_admin | default(false))
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.active is sameas true
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.revoked is sameas false
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.user_id == gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.id
        - gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.scopes == ['api']
    - ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        gitlab_group_binding: "{{ lookup('file',gitlab_native_group_receipt_file) | from_json }}"
    - ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: '{{ gitlab_native_origin }}/api/v4/groups/{{ gitlab_group_binding.parent_id }}/{{ item }}'
        headers: '{{ gitlab_native_headers }}'
      loop:
      - 'members/{{ gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.id }}'
      - 'access_tokens/{{ gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.id }}'
      register: gitlab_writer_authority
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - gitlab_writer_authority.results[0].json.id == gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.id
        - gitlab_writer_authority.results[0].json.access_level == 50
        - gitlab_writer_authority.results[1].json.id == gitlab_writer_identity.results[1].json.id
        - gitlab_writer_authority.results[1].json.user_id == gitlab_writer_identity.results[0].json.id
        - gitlab_writer_authority.results[1].json.access_level == 50
    - ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: '{{ gitlab_native_origin }}/api/v4/{{ item }}'
        headers: '{{ gitlab_native_headers }}'
      loop: ['version','groups/{{ gitlab_native_group_id }}','groups/{{ gitlab_group_binding.parent_id }}']
      register: gitlab_native_identity
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[0].json.version in ['19.4.2','19.4.2-ee']
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[1].json.id == gitlab_native_group_id
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[1].json.full_path == gitlab_native_group_path
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[1].json.visibility == 'private'
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[1].json.parent_id == gitlab_group_binding.parent_id
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[2].json.id == gitlab_group_binding.parent_id
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[2].json.full_path == 'tenants'
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[2].json.visibility == 'private'
        - gitlab_native_identity.results[2].json.parent_id == none
    - name: Recheck native account remains active without privileged identity access
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: '{{ gitlab_native_origin }}/api/v4/users/{{ gitlab_native_user_id }}'
        headers: '{{ gitlab_native_headers }}'
      register: gitlab_native_user
      when: gitlab_membership_operation != 'revoke'
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - gitlab_native_user.json.id == gitlab_native_user_id
        - gitlab_native_user.json.state == 'active'
      when: gitlab_membership_operation != 'revoke'
    - ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: '{{ gitlab_native_origin }}/api/v4/groups/{{ gitlab_native_group_id }}/{{ item }}/{{ gitlab_native_user_id }}'
        headers: '{{ gitlab_native_headers }}'
        status_code: [200,404]
      loop: [members, members/all]
      register: gitlab_native_before
    - ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
        - item.json.id == gitlab_native_user_id
        - item.json.access_level == gitlab_native_access_level
        - item.json.expires_at | default(none) == none
        - item.json.membership_state | default('active') == 'active'
      loop: '{{ gitlab_native_before.results }}'
      when: item.status == 200
    - ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: '{{ gitlab_native_grant_receipt_file }}'
      register: gitlab_prior_grant
    - name: Existing direct membership requires our protected prior ownership receipt
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: gitlab_prior_grant.stat.exists
      when: gitlab_membership_operation == 'grant' and gitlab_native_before.results[0].status == 200
    - name: A revoked receipt cannot authorize adoption or removal of a later external grant
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: (lookup('file',gitlab_native_grant_receipt_file) | from_json).stage in ['Granted','GrantPending']
      when: gitlab_native_before.results[0].status == 200 and gitlab_prior_grant.stat.exists
    - name: Do not duplicate or implicitly adopt inherited access
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: gitlab_native_before.results[1].status == 404
      when: gitlab_membership_operation == 'grant' and gitlab_native_before.results[0].status == 404
    - name: Record bounded intent before uncertain native write
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ gitlab_native_grant_receipt_file }}'
        mode: '0600'
        content: "{{ {'schema':1,'origin':gitlab_native_origin,'context':gitlab_membership_context,'subject':gitlab_native_subject,'source_revision':gitlab_membership_source_revision,'native_user_id':gitlab_native_user_id,'group_id':gitlab_native_group_id,'role':gitlab_native_role,'access_level':gitlab_native_access_level,'stage':'GrantPending','attempted_at':now(utc=true,fmt='%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')} | to_nice_json }}"
      when: gitlab_membership_operation == 'grant' and gitlab_native_before.results[0].status == 404

"""Pure, versioned identity naming/authority contract; no I/O or native actions."""
import hashlib
import json
import re


def derive(context):
    if not isinstance(context, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}', context) or context.endswith('-') or context in {'platform', 'tenants', 'system', 'default'}:
        raise ValueError('InvalidIdentityContext')
    legacy = context == 'portal'
    kc_policy = 'tenant-identity-bootstrap-keycloak-v1' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-bootstrap-keycloak-{context}-v1'
    eso = 'eso-identity-keycloak' if legacy else f'eso-identity-keycloak-{context}'
    result = {
        'schema': 1, 'context': context,
        'binding': 'portal-legacy-v1' if legacy else 'tenant-derived-v1',
        'client_id': f'perkforge-{context}-identity-reader',
        'actor_policy_name': f'perkforge-{context}-reader-actor',
        'permission_name': f'perkforge-{context}-reader-groups',
        'record': f'identity/keycloak/{context}-membership-reader-v1',
        'bootstrap_policy': kc_policy,
        'eso_policy': eso, 'eso_role': eso, 'eso_service_account': eso,
        'writer_namespace': 'tenant-identity-writer' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-{context}-writer',
        'attestor_namespace': 'tenant-identity-attestor' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-{context}-attestor',
        'evidence_name': f'{context}-identity-evidence',
        'group_reconciler': 'identity-group-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-group-reconciler',
        'attestor_reconciler': 'identity-attestor-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-attestor-reconciler',
        'declaration_reconciler': 'identity-declaration-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-declaration-reconciler',
        'declaration_policy': 'identity-declaration-scope' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-declaration-scope',
        'evidence_policy': 'identity-evidence-fields' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-evidence-fields',
        'phase_prefix': f'identity-{context}',
        'writer_eso_role': 'eso-identity-writer' if legacy else f'eso-identity-writer-{context}',
        'writer_eso_service_account': 'eso-identity-writer' if legacy else f'eso-identity-writer-{context}',
        'reader_eso_role': 'eso-identity-reader' if legacy else f'eso-identity-reader-{context}',
        'reader_eso_service_account': 'eso-identity-reader' if legacy else f'eso-identity-reader-{context}',
        'gitlab_writer_record': 'identity/gitlab/tenants-writer-v1',
        'gitlab_reader_record': 'identity/gitlab/tenant-reader-v1',
    }
    result['digest'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
    return result


def policy_text(context):

            f'path "platform/metadata/{d["record"]}" {{ capabilities = ["read"] }}\n'
            f'path "platform/data/{d["record"]}" {{ capabilities = ["create", "update", "read"] }}\n')

"""Pure, versioned identity naming/authority contract; no I/O or native actions."""
import hashlib
import json
import re


def derive(context):
    if not isinstance(context, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}', context) or context.endswith('-') or context in {'platform', 'tenants', 'system', 'default'}:
        raise ValueError('InvalidIdentityContext')
    legacy = context == 'portal'
    kc_policy = 'tenant-identity-bootstrap-keycloak-v1' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-bootstrap-keycloak-{context}-v1'
    eso = 'eso-identity-keycloak' if legacy else f'eso-identity-keycloak-{context}'
    result = {
        'schema': 1, 'context': context,
        'binding': 'portal-legacy-v1' if legacy else 'tenant-derived-v1',
        'client_id': f'perkforge-{context}-identity-reader',
        'actor_policy_name': f'perkforge-{context}-reader-actor',
        'permission_name': f'perkforge-{context}-reader-groups',
        'record': f'identity/keycloak/{context}-membership-reader-v1',
        'bootstrap_policy': kc_policy,
        'eso_policy': eso, 'eso_role': eso, 'eso_service_account': eso,
        'writer_namespace': 'tenant-identity-writer' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-{context}-writer',
        'attestor_namespace': 'tenant-identity-attestor' if legacy else f'tenant-identity-{context}-attestor',
        'evidence_name': f'{context}-identity-evidence',
        'group_reconciler': 'identity-group-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-group-reconciler',
        'attestor_reconciler': 'identity-attestor-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-attestor-reconciler',
        'declaration_reconciler': 'identity-declaration-reconciler' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-declaration-reconciler',
        'declaration_policy': 'identity-declaration-scope' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-declaration-scope',
        'evidence_policy': 'identity-evidence-fields' if legacy else f'identity-{context}-evidence-fields',
        'phase_prefix': f'identity-{context}',
        'writer_eso_role': 'eso-identity-writer' if legacy else f'eso-identity-writer-{context}',
        'writer_eso_service_account': 'eso-identity-writer' if legacy else f'eso-identity-writer-{context}',
        'reader_eso_role': 'eso-identity-reader' if legacy else f'eso-identity-reader-{context}',
        'reader_eso_service_account': 'eso-identity-reader' if legacy else f'eso-identity-reader-{context}',
        'gitlab_writer_record': 'identity/gitlab/tenants-writer-v1',
        'gitlab_reader_record': 'identity/gitlab/tenant-reader-v1',
    }
    result['digest'] = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
    return result


def policy_text(context):
    """Exact single-record custody ACL, including its own policy readback."""

            f'path "platform/metadata/{d["record"]}" {{ capabilities = ["read"] }}\n'
            f'path "platform/data/{d["record"]}" {{ capabilities = ["create", "update", "read"] }}\n')
